skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply key characteristics of object-oriented programming to define classes and objects.
Apply inheritance and polymorphism to demonstrate hierarchical features in object-oriented programming.
Apply object-oriented programming methods to construct programs for solving problems.
Proficiently perform analysis, design, and construction of individual functions using object-oriented programming methods.
Proficiently program solutions to problems using object-oriented programming methods.
Demonstrate ability to independently study and work in groups, understanding responsibilities and professional ethics.
Define classes and their components in object-oriented programming.
Create objects and arrays of objects in object-oriented programming.
Handle input/output streams and file operations in object-oriented programming.
Understand and use abstract classes in object-oriented programming.
Understand and use virtual functions in object-oriented programming.
Understand and apply multiple inheritance in object-oriented programming.
Demonstrate independent study habits and group collaboration skills.
Follow classroom rules and exhibit cooperative and responsible behavior.
